narrative_engine.thesis: Volatility is coiled (ATR percentile 6%, EMA spread -31.32 ATR) — the honest play is patience. Do NOT fade the range: compression resolves explosively, and the highest-value action is standing ready with the M1 pullback plan the moment a stack aligns.

athena_oracle.verdict: Neutral equilibrium 48/100 — trend broken, bid-wall floor, funding still cool
